title: kithd outbox: SELECT+UPDATE pattern has TOCTOU if two goroutines race on same entry
description: outbox.rs complete_delivery_in_tx now does SELECT 1 ... WHERE id=? AND delivery_state \!= 'delivered' (probe), then advance_state_counter_in_tx, then UPDATE. In Phase 1 (single-writer, one outbox worker) this is safe. If Phase 2 adds concurrent outbox workers, two workers could both see exists=true for the same entry before either advances the counter, resulting in a double counter advance with one UPDATE actually hitting the row and one hitting 0 rows (because the first UPDATE already set delivery_state='delivered'). The second worker silently advances the counter without writing the row — a phantom state advance. The guard 'WHERE delivery_state \!= delivered' on the UPDATE prevents double-marking, but the counter advance already happened. Phase 1 safe; document the Phase 2 hazard explicitly in the code.
